The walls ofthe stomacharethickandmuscular.Oncethefood enters the stomach,
its walls contract to churn (breakdown)thefood into smaller particles.This is the
mechanical digestion of food.The churning action also produces heat which helps
to melt the lipids in the food.
The inner walls of the stomach have many gastric glands. They secrete gastric juice
into the stomach. The gastric juice contains mucus, pepsinogen enzyme and
hydrochloric acid. Hydrochloric acid converts the inactive pepsinogen into an
active enzyme called pepsin. Pepsin breaks large protein molecules into shorter
